units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 1:9">Ter. I, 9</cite> <he>ונמלך לדוֹרְכָן</he> and after consideration decided to use them for pressing.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>עתיד לִדְרוֹךְ וכ׳</he> He will tread with His shoe upon &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 1:8">Ter. I, 8</cite> <he>ענבים הנִדְרָכוֹת</he> (Mish. ed. <he>הנִדְרָכִים</he>) grapes in the press or intended for the press.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 76b">Snh. 76ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 62b:19">Yeb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>המַּדְרִיךְ בניו וכ׳</he> he who leads his sons … on the right path.
